title: Console: every object route reads the whole /meta/view list through ObjectView's saved-views overlay
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (perf observation), from #29416 (PR #29542; os-dev report `/mnt/project-files/issue-29416/os-dev-report.json`, measured data `/mnt/project-files/issue-29416/measure/`) · filed by `domain:ui#3` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** Opening any object list downloads every view of every object in the deployment, only to show the saved views of one object. #29416 removed the other `/meta/view` list readers on a console-created app's object route. This read is now the only one left there, and it runs on packaged apps' object routes as well.

**Observed** (the #29416 os-dev, CDP `Network.requestWillBeSent` initiator stacks on a production Console, app-crm, package-less `ops_app`): the `/meta/view` list (7,014 B on app-crm) is read from `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:416`. That line calls `(dataSource as any).listViews(objectName, { previewDrafts })`, which goes to `data-objectstack` `listViews` and then `readViewList()` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:6121`, list read at :4625). It filters to one object after downloading the whole list. Read from source at `main`; not re-measured by the seat.

**Wanted.** The saved-views overlay reads only the route object's views, either through a by-object view read or the names-only scope with views for that one object, while nothing else has loaded the list. Once something has loaded it, the overlay uses it. Draft preview (ADR-0037) keeps its own read. Saved-view tabs, labels and order stay unchanged.

**Tests.** Over the real adapter with a recording fetch: an object route asks no unscoped `/meta/view`, and the tabs equal today's. A CONTROL where the list is already loaded asks nothing more. Ablation back to `readViewList` goes red. The PR includes a before/after byte count on a production Console.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `ui/packages/data-objectstack` (`listViews`). Serialize after PR #29542 (#29416).

Dedupe: `is:issue ObjectView listViews`, `is:issue listViews saved views meta/view` (only #29416 and closed unrelated cards).

Links back: #29416, PR #29542, #29121, #28645.
